What the agent does and when to delegate to it; Claude reads it to decide, e.g. Builds and merges changes

nodes.docs: Unique identifier for the agent, a UUID version 7; the harness writes it into Claude's name, so renaming the agent never breaks a session, e.g. 0193b2c4-7d1e-7a3f-9c2e-5b8a1d4e6f70
Reasoning effort for the agent's model, from low to max; the levels available depend on the model, and left out, Claude uses the session's, e.g. high
MCP servers the agent can reach, by the name of a server configured elsewhere, e.g. github

nodes.docs: Folder the agent keeps notes in across sessions, named after its id; user spans every project, project is committed with the repo, and local stays out of version control, e.g. project
Model the agent runs on, as provider/model with the provider's own model id; left out, Claude picks one, e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-5-5

nodes.docs: Place of the agent in the team; a main agent sits at the top, above the orchestrators; an orchestrator is persistent, owns one area of the work and splits it into tasks for subagents; a subagent is started for one task and ends when it is done, and an agent with no role is one, e.g. orchestrator
Skills loaded into the agent's context when it starts, by name, e.g. api-conventions
